title: Quadrilateral Property Match
prompt: Match each quadrilateral clue with the shape it describes best.

pairs.left: Opposite angles are equal and adjacent angles are supplementary.
Exactly one pair of opposite sides is parallel.
All four angles are right angles.
All sides are equal and all angles are right angles.

fallback.markdown:
- Opposite angles equal and adjacent angles supplementary -> Parallelogram
- Exactly one pair of opposite sides parallel -> Trapezoid
- All four angles are right angles -> Rectangle
- All sides equal and all angles right -> Square
